title: Need Money Now? How to Use Gig Work Without Losing Your Plan
description: Gig work is more than delivery. Using the Enaasan Gig Work Skill Pyramid, 18+ 12th-pass, diploma and graduate youth who need income after moving to a city can find the level they can enter, read earnings claims honestly, protect study time, check their safety net and avoid scams.
target_audience: 18+ youth (12th pass, ITI/diploma, graduates) needing immediate or part-time income
questions_it_answers: What gig work can I do after 12th?
What gig work can I do with an ITI or diploma?
How do I earn money while preparing for exams?
How do I work out real hourly earnings from gig work?
What insurance do gig workers get?
How do I avoid job scams?
